Great place to relax in Hanoi
Sep 2026 • Couples
We had a really great time here. The pool is beautiful, the atmosphere is very relaxing, and the food was honestly one of the highlights, everything we tried was really delicious.

It was a great experience and we’re very glad we found this place during our time in Hanoi. The staff were lovely and made us feel very welcome.

If you’re visiting Hanoi and want somewhere to relax, enjoy a beautiful pool and have some really good food, I would definitely recommend coming here. We had a great time and would happily come back!

Sep 2026 • Couples
We had such a wonderful experience here! The pool is absolutely beautiful and was the perfect place to relax and enjoy a few hours away from the busy city.

The food was also really, really delicious, everything we tried was fresh and full of flavor. We had such a lovely time from beginning to end.

We’re very happy we discovered this place and had the opportunity to experience it. Thank you so much for having us!

If you’re visiting Hanoi and looking for a beautiful place to enjoy a pool, have great food and simply relax, we definitely recommend adding this place to your list. It’s absolutely worth visiting!

Having a morning drink at Sky Lounge is definitely a must-try experience. It is the perfect place to recharge. One of the highlights of Sky Lounge is definitely the rooftop pool - a place to relax and enjoy the panoramic view of the city. Definitely worth a try.
